text:
scan-bot: [FAIL] SAST job failed on branch `main` — KMS decrypt permissionDenied for artifact key (req=xyz-789). tagging eng-security for triage

alex: looks like recent RBAC cleanup removed the decrypter role from the scanner SA. PR 1219 changed group bindings.

mia: that was my cleanup PR. I removed a transitive binding that I thought was unused. didn't expect scanner SA to be relying on it.

david: before we change anything, can someone grab the audit log entry + exact principal/time so we can correlate with the CI run?

alex: got it: Cloud Audit shows `permissionDenied` for `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/artifacts/decrypt` at 2026-03-20T17:18:05Z by `serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. gcloud snippet I ran: `gcloud logging read \"resource.type=api AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\\\"scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com\\\" AND protoPayload.status.code=7\" --limit=10`

jen: oncall notified. short-term rollback or ephemeral grant? Which is faster?

samir: ephemeral grant is fastest. I'll add a scoped binding with condition and short TTL, re-run the scanner.

samir: ran command: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/artifacts --member=serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --condition=expression=resource.name.contains(\"artifacts\"),title=scanner-scope`

scan-bot: [INFO] Re-run queued by samir (build 4523).

alex: re-run passed. ephemeral binding worked.

david: good. follow-ups: 1) update runbook with exact gcloud queries + remediation steps, 2) add CI preflight that flags PRs removing KMS-related roles without owning-team approval, 3) enrich scanner errors to call out `authz` vs `transient network`

mia: agreed. I'll revert my cleanup and open a new PR that removes the transitive binding but preserves explicit scanner decryption via conditioned binding.

jen: created SEC-2027: "scanner KMS authz hard-fail — runbook + scanner UX + preflight". I'll own until complete. https://issues.redwood.ai/SEC-2027

alex: another ops ask — add the CI job id as a correlation_id to the KMS request metadata so audit logs show the build id. makes triage much faster than guessing.

samir: doable, will add correlation header from CI agent. also can add a QuickSight/Datadog dashboard to surface recent decrypt failures by key and principal.

jen: putting all steps in SEC-2027: runbook patch, scanner change, CI telemetry, preflight gate. TL;DR: ephemeral grant unblocks, but we need better visibility + premerge guard rails.

alex: recommend scanner also return a remediation link in GH check when it gets permissionDenied with a single-click 'Request access' link that files a scoped waiver to the owning team.

mia: nice. I'll coordinate the owning-team signoff flow.

jen: thanks team — closing thread here, will update once SEC-2027 has PR links. :white_check_mark:
